import json, re, random, sys, time
import chess

RULES = json.load(open("re.json"))

def run(fen):
    for p, r in RULES:
        fen = re.sub(p, r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")

def expected(fen):
    b = chess.Board(fen)
    s = set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN:
            continue
        c = b.copy(); c.push(m)
        s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s

def check(fen):
    ours = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
    exp = expected(fen)
    ok = len(ours) == len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen)
        print(" extra:", [x for x in ours if not (x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp)])
        print(" missing:", exp - set(ours) - {x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" for x in ours})
        print(" counts", len(ours), len(exp))
    return ok

sample = "rnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P5/q4Kb1 w kq - 0 1"
out = "\n".join(run(sample))
print(out == "rnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P1K3/q5b1 b kq - 0 0\nrnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P1Q2/P1P3K1/q5b1 b kq - 0 0\nrnb1k1nr/p2p1ppp/3B4/1p1NPN1P/6P1/3P4/P1P5/q2Q1Kb1 b kq - 0 0" or sorted(out.split("\n")))
fails = 0; n = 0; t = time.time()
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0)
N = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 300
for g in range(N):
    b = chess.Board()
    for ply in range(random.randint(1, 150)):
        if b.is_game_over(): break
        moves = list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias toward interesting moves
        sp = [m for m in moves if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(sp) if sp and random.random() < 0.7 else random.choice(moves))
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE and not b.is_game_over():
            n += 1
            if not check(b.fen()):
                fails += 1
                if fails > 5: sys.exit(1)
print("tested", n, "fails", fails, "time", time.time() - t)
